title: validate_package inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the read-only composition-review tool (advertised name honua_validate_package). Inspects a map/app package's requirement coverage (data bindings, permissions, schema, CRS, capabilities, dependencies, approvals) and returns canonical findings without mutating server state. x-honua-reference-shape: tracks the reference implementation; the bare taxonomy models package review as a CapabilityCatalog + resource read.

contractVersion.description: Package-review contract version. Current value is honua.package_review.v1.

packageFamily.description: Supported values are query, analysis_plan, map_package, dashboard_report, form, app_package, workflow, gp, and etl. Missing or unknown values are returned as canonical missing_package_family or unsupported_package_family findings rather than rejected by the schema.

packagePayload.description: Opaque package payload inspected only by the matching package-family adapter.

requirements.description: Shared data binding, permission, schema, CRS, capability, dependency, and approval requirements. An explicit null is normalized to an empty requirement set.

resourceRefs.description: Safe caller-visible resource references. An explicit null is normalized to an empty map.
